views.definition:
SELECT dl.item_id,
    m.owner_id,
    m.location_id,
    sum(m.quantity_delta) AS quantity
   FROM ((stock_v2.movement m
     JOIN stock_v2.document_line dl ON ((dl.line_id = m.document_line_id)))
     JOIN stock_v2.document d ON ((d.document_id = dl.document_id)))
  WHERE (d.status = 'posted'::text)
  GROUP BY dl.item_id, m.owner_id, m.location_id;

SELECT m.external_tracecode_id,
    dl.item_id,
    m.owner_id,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (d.document_type = ANY (ARRAY['issue'::text, 'return'::text])) THEN (- m.quantity_delta)
            WHEN ((d.document_type = 'adjustment'::text) AND (parent.document_type = 'issue'::text)) THEN (- m.quantity_delta)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END) AS net_applied
   FROM (((stock_v2.movement m
     JOIN stock_v2.document_line dl ON ((dl.line_id = m.document_line_id)))
     JOIN stock_v2.document d ON ((d.document_id = dl.document_id)))
     LEFT JOIN stock_v2.document parent ON ((parent.document_id = d.parent_document_id)))
  WHERE ((d.status = 'posted'::text) AND ((d.document_type = ANY (ARRAY['issue'::text, 'return'::text])) OR ((d.document_type = 'adjustment'::text) AND (parent.document_type = 'issue'::text))) AND (m.external_tracecode_id IS NOT NULL))
  GROUP BY m.external_tracecode_id, dl.item_id, m.owner_id;

WITH req AS (
         SELECT requirement.owner_id,
            requirement.item_id,
            sum(requirement.planned_quantity) AS planned_quantity
           FROM stock_v2.requirement
          WHERE ((requirement.status = 'active'::text) AND (requirement.owner_id IS NOT NULL))
          GROUP BY requirement.owner_id, requirement.item_id
        ), stocks AS (
         SELECT quantity_balance.owner_id,
            quantity_balance.item_id,
            sum(GREATEST(quantity_balance.quantity, (0)::numeric)) AS stock_quantity
           FROM stock_v2.quantity_balance
          GROUP BY quantity_balance.owner_id, quantity_balance.item_id
        ), orders AS (
         SELECT oh.owner_id,
            ol.item_id,
            sum((ol.ordered_quantity - ol.received_quantity)) AS on_order
           FROM (stock_v2.order_header oh
             JOIN stock_v2.order_line ol USING (order_id))
          WHERE (oh.status = 'approved'::text)
          GROUP BY oh.owner_id, ol.item_id
        )
 SELECT r.owner_id,
    r.item_id,
    r.planned_quantity,
    COALESCE(s.stock_quantity, (0)::numeric) AS stock_quantity,
    COALESCE(o.on_order, (0)::numeric) AS on_order,
    GREATEST((0)::numeric, ((r.planned_quantity - COALESCE(s.stock_quantity, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(o.on_order, (0)::numeric))) AS to_order
   FROM ((req r
     LEFT JOIN stocks s ON (((s.owner_id = r.owner_id) AND (s.item_id = r.item_id))))
     LEFT JOIN orders o ON (((o.owner_id = r.owner_id) AND (o.item_id = r.item_id))));

SELECT sd.spray_date_id,
    s.spray_id,
    sd.tracecode_id AS external_tracecode_id,
    s.input_id,
    tc.tracecode_size,
    tc.planned_planting_date,
    tc.actual_planting_date,
    s.rate_per_ha,
    ((s.rate_per_ha * tc.tracecode_size))::numeric(20,6) AS required_quantity,
    om.owner_id,
    i.item_id,
        CASE
            WHEN ((om.owner_id IS NULL) OR (om.verified IS NOT TRUE)) THEN 'ownership_unverified'::text
            WHEN (i.item_id IS NULL) THEN 'item_unmapped'::text
            WHEN ((tc.tracecode_size IS NULL) OR (tc.tracecode_size <= (0)::numeric) OR (s.rate_per_ha IS NULL) OR (s.rate_per_ha <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'invalid_rate_or_area'::text
            ELSE 'ready'::text
        END AS mapping_status
   FROM ((((spray s
     JOIN spray_date sd ON ((sd.spray_date_id = s.spray_date_id)))
     JOIN tracecode tc ON ((tc.tracecode_id = sd.tracecode_id)))
     LEFT JOIN stock_v2.tracecode_owner_map om ON ((om.external_tracecode_id = tc.tracecode_id)))
     LEFT JOIN stock_v2.item i ON ((i.existing_input_id = s.input_id)));

SELECT sprayer_asset_code,
    (EXTRACT(isoyear FROM planned_week_start))::integer AS spray_year,
    sum(completed_area_ha) AS completed_hectares,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (completed_area_ha > (0)::numeric)) AS jobs_with_work
   FROM stock_v2.spray_job
  WHERE ((sprayer_asset_code IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'cancelled'::text))
  GROUP BY sprayer_asset_code, ((EXTRACT(isoyear FROM planned_week_start))::integer);

SELECT b.budget_ref_id,
    b.external_tracecode_id,
    b.item_id,
    b.days_after_planting,
    b.rate_per_ha,
    b.source_key,
    tc.tracecode_name,
    COALESCE(tc.actual_planting_date, tc.planned_planting_date) AS planting_date,
    stock_v2.week_start_for((COALESCE(tc.actual_planting_date, tc.planned_planting_date) + b.days_after_planting)) AS budget_week_start
   FROM (stock_v2.crop_budget_reference b
     JOIN tracecode tc ON ((tc.tracecode_id = b.external_tracecode_id)));

SELECT j.job_id,
    j.external_tracecode_id,
    j.owner_id,
    j.planned_week_start,
    j.area_ha,
    j.setup_id,
    ji.job_input_id,
    ji.item_id,
    ji.rate_per_ha,
    ((ji.rate_per_ha * j.area_ha))::numeric(20,6) AS planned_quantity,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum((- m.quantity_delta)) AS sum
           FROM ((stock_v2.document_line dl
             JOIN stock_v2.document d ON ((d.document_id = dl.document_id)))
             JOIN stock_v2.movement m ON ((m.document_line_id = dl.line_id)))
          WHERE ((dl.requirement_id = ji.requirement_id) AND (d.status = 'posted'::text) AND (d.document_type = 'issue'::text))), (0)::numeric) AS issued_quantity
   FROM (stock_v2.spray_job j
     JOIN stock_v2.spray_job_input ji ON ((ji.job_id = j.job_id)))
  WHERE (j.status = 'planned'::text);

SELECT t.tracecode_id AS external_tracecode_id,
    t.tracecode_name,
    m.owner_id,
    o.owner_code,
    m.verified AS owner_verified,
    ((m.verified IS TRUE) AND (m.owner_id IS NOT NULL) AND (o.active IS TRUE) AND (o.owner_code !~~ 'TEST%'::text)) AS ready_for_real_issue
   FROM ((tracecode t
     LEFT JOIN stock_v2.tracecode_owner_map m ON ((m.external_tracecode_id = t.tracecode_id)))
     LEFT JOIN stock_v2.owner o ON ((o.owner_id = m.owner_id)));

SELECT a.access_input_id,
    a.input_name,
    a.pastel_code,
    a.unit_text,
    i.item_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.base_unit,
    i.active AS stock_item_active
   FROM (stock_v2.access_input_catalog a
     LEFT JOIN stock_v2.item i ON ((i.access_input_id = a.access_input_id)));

WITH receipts AS (
         SELECT ol.item_id,
            h.supplier_name,
            d.posted_at,
            d.document_id
           FROM (((stock_v2.demo_grv_line_link x
             JOIN stock_v2.document d ON (((d.document_id = x.document_id) AND (d.status = 'posted'::text))))
             JOIN stock_v2.order_line ol ON ((ol.order_line_id = x.order_line_id)))
             JOIN stock_v2.order_header h ON ((h.order_id = ol.order_id)))
          WHERE (x.received_unit_price IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ol.item_id,
            h.supplier_name,
            d.posted_at,
            d.document_id
           FROM (((stock_v2.demo_grv_order_link x
             JOIN stock_v2.document d ON (((d.document_id = x.document_id) AND (d.status = 'posted'::text))))
             JOIN stock_v2.order_line ol ON ((ol.order_line_id = x.order_line_id)))
             JOIN stock_v2.order_header h ON ((h.order_id = ol.order_id)))
          WHERE (x.received_unit_price IS NOT NULL)
        )
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (item_id) item_id,
    supplier_name AS last_purchase_supplier
   FROM receipts
  ORDER BY item_id, posted_at DESC, document_id DESC;

WITH priced AS (
         SELECT i.item_id,
            x.qty,
            (x.received_unit_price)::numeric AS unit_price,
            d.posted_at,
            d.document_id
           FROM (((stock_v2.demo_grv_line_link x
             JOIN stock_v2.document d ON (((d.document_id = x.document_id) AND (d.status = 'posted'::text))))
             JOIN stock_v2.order_line ol ON ((ol.order_line_id = x.order_line_id)))
             JOIN stock_v2.item i ON ((i.item_id = ol.item_id)))
          WHERE (x.received_unit_price IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT ol.item_id,
            x.qty,
            (x.received_unit_price)::numeric AS received_unit_price,
            d.posted_at,
            d.document_id
           FROM ((stock_v2.demo_grv_order_link x
             JOIN stock_v2.document d ON (((d.document_id = x.document_id) AND (d.status = 'posted'::text))))
             JOIN stock_v2.order_line ol ON ((ol.order_line_id = x.order_line_id)))
          WHERE (x.received_unit_price IS NOT NULL)
        )
 SELECT item_id,
    (array_agg(unit_price ORDER BY posted_at DESC, document_id DESC))[1] AS last_purchase_price,
    (sum((qty * unit_price)) / NULLIF(sum(qty), (0)::numeric)) AS weighted_receipt_price,
    sum(qty) AS priced_receipt_quantity
   FROM priced
  GROUP BY item_id;

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stock_v2.normalize_spray_job_week()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin new.planned_week_start := date_trunc('week', new.planned_week_start::timestamp)::date; return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stock_v2.current_staff_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'stock_v2'
AS $function$
 select role_name from stock_v2.staff_role where user_id=auth.uid() and active
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stock_v2.audit_document_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'stock_v2'
AS $function$
begin
 if new.status is distinct from old.status and new.status in ('posted','void') then
  insert into stock_v2.workflow_audit(document_id,action,previous_status,new_status,actor_uid)
  values(new.document_id,case when new.status='posted' then 'posted' else 'voided' end,
         old.status,new.status,auth.uid());
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stock_v2.week_start_for(p_date date)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
select (p_date - (extract(isodow from p_date)::integer-1))::date
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stock_v2.set_spray_job_default_water_rate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'stock_v2'
AS $function$
begin
 if new.water_litres_per_ha is null and new.setup_id is not null then
   select water_litres_per_ha into new.water_litres_per_ha from stock_v2.sprayer_setup where setup_id=new.setup_id;
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION stock_v2.refresh_spray_job_requirements()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'stock_v2'
AS $function$
begin
 update stock_v2.requirement r set
 planned_quantity=(i.rate_per_ha*new.area_ha)::numeric(20,6),
 required_date=new.planned_week_start, owner_id=new.owner_id,
 status=case when new.status='planned' then 'active' else 'cancelled' end
 from stock_v2.spray_job_input i where i.job_id=new.job_id and i.requirement_id=r.requirement_id;
 return new;
end $function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER guard_lines BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON stock_v2.document_line FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.guard_child_changes()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_movements BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON stock_v2.movement FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.guard_child_changes()

CREATE TRIGGER document_status_audit AFTER UPDATE OF status ON stock_v2.document FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.audit_document_status()
CREATE TRIGGER guard_document BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON stock_v2.document FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.guard_document_changes()
CREATE TRIGGER validate_admin_adjustment BEFORE UPDATE ON stock_v2.document FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.validate_admin_adjustment()
CREATE TRIGGER validate_ownership_transfer BEFORE UPDATE ON stock_v2.document FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.validate_ownership_transfer()
CREATE TRIGGER grv_price_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON stock_v2.grv_line_price FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.guard_grv_line_price()
CREATE TRIGGER charge_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON stock_v2.owner_charge FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.guard_owner_charge()
CREATE TRIGGER grv_details_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON stock_v2.grv_detail FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.guard_grv_details()
CREATE TRIGGER spray_job_input_requirement AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF rate_per_ha, item_id ON stock_v2.spray_job_input FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.sync_spray_job_requirement()
CREATE TRIGGER normalize_spray_job_week_before_write BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF planned_week_start ON stock_v2.spray_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.normalize_spray_job_week()
CREATE TRIGGER refresh_spray_job_req AFTER UPDATE OF area_ha, planned_week_start, owner_id, status ON stock_v2.spray_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.refresh_spray_job_requirements()
CREATE TRIGGER spray_job_water_default BEFORE INSERT ON stock_v2.spray_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.set_spray_job_default_water_rate()
CREATE TRIGGER accounting_grv_allocation_check BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON stock_v2.accounting_grv_allocation FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stock_v2.accounting_grv_check_allocation()
